title: ₹38 Lakh Pipeline for a D2C Logistics Tech Company
challenge: A logistics technology provider wanted to expand into fast-growing D2C brands but struggled to identify the right operations stakeholders.
solution: Myntmore targeted operations heads, supply chain managers and founders of growing eCommerce businesses. Campaigns were structured around fulfilment efficiency, delivery experience and logistics scalability.
results: Stronger access to D2C operations leadership.
